chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Uqda narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Yusuf ibn Ya'qub al-Ja'fi, Abu al-Hasan, narrated to us, saying: Isma'il ibn Mihran narrated to us, saying: al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza narrated to us, from his father and Wahb ibn Hafs, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said one day:

"Shall I inform you of that which Allah does not accept any deed from His servants except through it?" I said: "Yes." He said: "Testifying that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, and affirming what Allah has commanded, and Wilayah (guardianship) for us, and disavowal from our enemies (meaning the Imams specifically), and submission to them, and piety (al-Wara'), and striving (al-Ijtihad), and tranquility, and waiting for the Qa'im."
Then he said: "Indeed, for us is a dominion/state that Allah will bring about when He wills."

Then he said: "Whoever is pleased to be among the companions of the Qa'im, let him wait and practice piety and good character while he is waiting. If he dies and the Qa'im rises after him, he will have a reward equal to the reward of one who accompanied him."
So strive and wait. Good news for you, O the mercified group!

key_terms.الْبَرَاءَةُ: Disavowal or enmity towards the enemies of the Imams
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Awaited Imam, who will rise to fill the earth with justice
key_terms.الْوَرَعُ: Piety and God-consciousness, avoiding doubtful matters
key_terms.الْوِلَايَةُ: Guardianship or authority, specifically referring to the Imams

ai.seo_question: What are the key conditions for accepted deeds and the reward of waiting for the Qa'im according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the comprehensive framework for accepted worship by integrating theological pillars—such as Wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt and Bara'ah from enemies—with practical spiritual states like piety (Wara') and active anticipation (Intizar). This narration underscores the Shia doctrine of 'Waiting for the Deliverance' not as passive inactivity, but as a dynamic state of readiness where one’s deeds are validated by their alignment with the Imam’s authority, promising that those who die in this state share the full reward of those who physically accompany the Qa'im.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (16) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed bin Oqda narrated from Ahmad bin Yousuf bin Ya’qoob al-Ju’fi Abul Hasan from Issma’eel bin Mihran from al-Hasan bin Ali bin Abu Hamza from his father and Wuhayb bin Hafs from Abu Baseer that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said one day:

“Do I tell you of that which Allah does not accept any doing from His people except with?” The narrator said: “Yes, please!” He said: “Witnessing that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, submitting to the orders of Allah, believing in the guardianship of the infallible imams, submitting to them and disavowing their enemies, piety, sincerity of faith and waiting for al-Qa’im (as).
There will be a state for us, Ahlul Bayt. Allah achieves that when He wills.

Whoever likes to be one of al-Qa’im’s companions has to wait while being pious and acting morally. If that one dies before the advent of al-Qa’im (as), he will be rewarded as if he has accompanied al-Qa’im (as).
Try your best (in being pious) and wait. How lucky you are, O you the mercified group!”
